shared: T cell antigen processing and presentation
negative regulation of MHC class II biosynthetic process
Gene and protein expression by JAK-STAT signaling after Interleukin-12 stimulation

reading_1.theme: T cell activation at the immunological synapse
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame antigen presentation and IL-12/JAK-STAT signalling as the activating inputs to T cells, whose physical execution is the polarized synapse, raft clustering and cytoskeletal reorganization in the additional set.

reading_2.theme: IL-12 and IFN-gamma driven Th1 immunity
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are antigen presentation and IL-12/JAK-STAT signalling, serving as the antigen-presenting-cell-to-T-cell priming inputs that drive Th1 differentiation and IFN-gamma-regulated MHC expression.

reading_1.theme: Water-soluble vitamin and cofactor metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover riboflavin, thiamine, choline and carnitine metabolism and transport, framed as part of a broad vitamin/cofactor metabolism theme alongside cobalamin, folate, biotin and methionine one-carbon pathways.

reading_2.theme: B-vitamin and one-carbon micronutrient metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe riboflavin and thiamine transport and metabolism, choline catabolism and carnitine synthesis, framed as part of water-soluble vitamin and one-carbon metabolism with folate, cobalamin and methionine cycling.

shared: positive regulation of transcription of Notch receptor target

reading_1.theme: Notch signalling transcriptional output
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are Notch target-gene transcription (HES/HEY-type HLH output), the nuclear readout of NICD signalling across Notch paralogs, oncogenic mutants and developmental contexts such as Th2 and pancreatic differentiation.

reading_2.theme: Notch signalling and transcriptional regulation of targets
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are Notch-driven HLH target transcription, framed as the nuclear output of NOTCH1-4 intracellular domains in development, T helper differentiation and oncogenic NOTCH1 mutants.

shared: regulation of barbed-end actin filament capping
positive regulation of actin filament depolymerization
negative regulation of Arp2/3 complex-mediated actin nucleation

reading_1.theme: Actin filament turnover at the leading edge
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are actin severing, depolymerization, capping and Arp2/3 control, framed as actin dynamics that drive lamellipodium and pseudopodium protrusion.

reading_2.theme: Actin filament turnover driving protrusions and cell shape
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover cofilin/gelsolin-type actin disassembly: severing, depolymerization, barbed-end capping and restraint of Arp2/3 nucleation. This recycles actin so filopodia, ruffles and polarized cell shape can be remodelled downstream of EPHB and Rho-family signalling, including at synapses.

shared: regulation of secondary heart field cardioblast proliferation
apoptotic process involved in heart morphogenesis

reading_1.theme: Second heart field-driven cardiac morphogenesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover specification, proliferation and differentiation of second heart field progenitors. These cells build the right ventricle, the septum and the ascending aorta/outflow, with endocardial and mesenchymal contributions to valve morphogenesis.

reading_2.theme: Embryonic heart development and cardiac morphogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover second heart field specification, cardiomyocyte, endocardial and septal differentiation and ventricle/aorta formation, framed as the early lineage-building steps of heart chamber morphogenesis.

shared: positive regulation of proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process
obsolete positive regulation of proteolysis involved in protein catabolic process

reading_1.theme: Regulation of proteasomal protein degradation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the promotion of ubiquitin-proteasome degradation and protein destabilization (plus stabilization), framed against negative regulation of proteolysis in the control of protein turnover.

reading_2.theme: Protein homeostasis: ubiquitin-mediated degradation versus chaperone folding
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame the balance between stabilizing proteins and targeting them for proteasomal degradation (including the CUL3 adaptor RHOBTB2) as the turnover side of proteostasis, complemented by TRiC/CCT folding and ubiquitination control.

shared: negative regulation of cardiac muscle adaptation
positive regulation of cell growth involved in cardiac muscle cell development
positive regulation of cardiac muscle adaptation

reading_1.theme: Cardiomyocyte hypertrophy and cell size control
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe positive and negative regulation of cardiac muscle adaptation, cardiomyocyte growth, cell size and sarcomere organisation, framed here as the hypertrophic growth response to stress driven by calcineurin-NFAT signalling.

reading_2.theme: Muscle growth and adaptive remodeling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover control of cardiomyocyte size, sarcomere organization and hypertrophic adaptation. This is the cardiac case of muscle adaptation, alongside skeletal muscle atrophy, regeneration and fiber-type switching in response to activity.

shared: regulation of telomere maintenance in response to DNA damage
negative regulation of double-strand break repair via nonhomologous end joining

reading_1.theme: DNA repair at replication forks with ADP-ribosylation and chromatin
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the DNA-structural side of genome maintenance, topological change, fork reversal, R-loop processing and repair pathway choice, regulated by PARP-mediated ADP-ribosylation and chromatin remodelling.

reading_2.theme: Replication stress responses and DNA topology at stalled forks
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe fork reversal, R-loop processing, DNA topological change and protein-DNA complex disassembly, framed here as the remodelling of DNA structure at stalled replication forks that underlies responses to topoisomerase poisons, hydroxyurea and DNA-protein cross-links.

reading_1.theme: Extracellular matrix collagen and elastic fibre assembly
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are collagen biosynthesis and fibril organisation together with elastic fibre assembly, i.e. building the structural fibres of the extracellular matrix that crosslinking then stabilises.

reading_2.theme: Extracellular matrix collagen and elastic fibre assembly
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover collagen synthesis and fibril organisation and elastic fibre assembly. This is the structural ECM programme, completed by collagen crosslinking.

shared: Defective neurotransmitter clearance by SLC6A3 causes Parkinsonism-dystonia infantile (PKDYS)
Defective transport of neurotransmitters by SLC6A3 causes Parkinsonism-dystonia infantile (PKDYS)
obsolete catecholamine uptake involved in synaptic transmission
obsolete regulation of catecholamine uptake involved in synaptic transmission

reading_1.theme: Dopaminergic neurotransmission and psychostimulant response
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are catecholamine synthesis and presynaptic reuptake by DAT/NET transporters, framed as the control of synaptic dopamine levels that sets receptor signalling and is the target of cocaine and amphetamine.

reading_2.theme: Catecholamine synthesis, reuptake and synaptic neurotransmission
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame dopamine and norepinephrine synthesis and transporter-mediated reuptake (DAT, NET and their disease variants) as the production and clearance ends of catecholaminergic synaptic transmission.

shared: negative regulation of protein targeting to membrane
regulation of Rab protein signal transduction
regulation of endosome to plasma membrane protein transport

reading_1.theme: Golgi, endosome and lysosome vesicular trafficking
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are Rab-GTPase-regulated endocytic recycling, endosome organization and constitutive secretion, framed as the receptor recycling and secretion branch of the Golgi-endosome-lysosome sorting network.

reading_2.theme: Endosomal and Golgi membrane trafficking
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are Rab-regulated endocytic recycling and endosome-to-plasma membrane traffic, framed within the Golgi-endosome-lysosome trafficking network, which also covers retrograde transport and secretion.

shared: positive regulation of DNA-directed DNA polymerase activity
Gap-filling DNA repair synthesis and ligation in GG-NER
DNA synthesis involved in DNA repair
DNA strand elongation involved in DNA replication
Recognition of DNA damage by PCNA-containing replication complex

reading_1.theme: DNA repair synthesis, replication and translesion synthesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the DNA polymerase machinery, replication fork synthesis, PCNA-based polymerase switching, translesion synthesis and gap filling, framed as the synthesis step common to excision, mismatch and other DNA repair pathways.

reading_2.theme: DNA repair synthesis and translesion replication
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover replicative DNA synthesis, PCNA-mediated polymerase switching and translesion synthesis, framed as the DNA synthesis steps used in excision repair, mismatch repair and damage tolerance.

shared: negative regulation of G0 to G1 transition

reading_1.theme: Oncogene-induced cellular senescence
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the induction of senescence by oncogenic stress and the block on re-entry into the cell cycle from quiescence, which the additional terms complete with senescence-associated heterochromatin formation and its negative regulation.

reading_2.theme: Oncogene-induced cellular senescence
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the induction of senescence and arrest of cell-cycle re-entry by oncogenic signalling, which is executed through senescence-associated heterochromatin formation.

shared: mesenchymal stem cell maintenance involved in nephron morphogenesis
regulation of mesenchymal to epithelial transition involved in metanephros morphogenesis
obsolete cell differentiation involved in metanephros development

reading_1.theme: Early kidney development: nephric duct to nephron induction
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame the metanephric mesenchyme's side of kidney formation, maintaining nephron progenitors and converting them to epithelial tubules in response to induction by the ureteric bud.

reading_2.theme: Early kidney development: intermediate mesoderm, ureteric bud, nephrogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe the metanephric mesenchyme side (intermediate mesoderm origin, progenitor maintenance, mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition into tubules), framed as the reciprocal partner of nephric duct and ureteric bud formation and branching.

reading_1.theme: Aldehyde/methylglyoxal detoxification and glutathione redox defence
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe methylglyoxal and aldehyde detoxification and protein repair of glycation damage, framed here as one branch of cellular chemical-stress defence that depends on glutathione synthesis, NADPH regeneration and ROS detoxification.

reading_2.theme: Tryptophan-kynurenine NAD+ synthesis and reactive aldehyde detoxification
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and repair of glycated proteins, a redox damage-control arm that the theme pairs with tryptophan-kynurenine NAD+ metabolism.

shared: protein insertion into mitochondrial inner membrane
protein insertion into mitochondrial inner membrane from matrix

reading_1.theme: Mitochondrial respiratory chain assembly and oxidative phosphorylation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are inner-membrane protein insertion and assembly of complexes I and III, framed as the building of the electron transport chain that drives oxidative phosphorylation.

reading_2.theme: Mitochondrial respiratory chain complex assembly
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe inner-membrane protein insertion and assembly of complexes I and III, framed here as part of oxidative phosphorylation biogenesis together with complex I and ATP synthase assembly.

shared: obsolete protein localization to endoplasmic reticulum exit site

reading_1.theme: Bidirectional ER-Golgi vesicle trafficking
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover COPI vesicle budding and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic. This is the retrieval and recycling counterpart to COPII-mediated cargo export from ER exit sites.

reading_2.theme: COPI vesicle trafficking between ER and Golgi
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are COPI vesicle budding and retrograde Golgi-to-ER traffic, framed as vesicle formation that pairs with vesicle targeting in the early secretory pathway.

shared: Loss of Function of KMT2D in MLL4 Complex Formation in Kabuki Syndrome

reading_1.theme: Epigenetic chromatin regulation by histone and DNA methylation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover the WDR5/MLL (KMT2D) histone lysine methyltransferase complexes, which are disrupted in Kabuki syndrome. They are the histone-methylation writer arm within a wider epigenetic programme that also includes repressive heterochromatin, DNA methylation, imprinting, X inactivation and retroelement silencing.

reading_2.theme: Chromatin modification and epigenetic gene silencing
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe histone lysine methylation by WDR5/MLL (KMT2) complexes, framed as one epigenetic layer alongside DNA methylation, PRC2, heterochromatin, imprinting and retroelement silencing.

shared: obsolete vesicle targeting, to, from or within Golgi
obsolete vesicle targeting, rough ER to cis-Golgi

reading_1.theme: ER-Golgi vesicle trafficking
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover vesicle targeting from the rough ER to the cis-Golgi. This is the forward (anterograde) leg of two-way ER-Golgi traffic, balanced by COPI retrograde transport.

reading_2.theme: Vesicle targeting in ER-Golgi trafficking
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe vesicle targeting between ER and Golgi, framed as the targeting step of COPI/COPII-mediated anterograde and retrograde early secretory traffic.

shared: Sodium-coupled sulphate, di- and tri-carboxylate transporters

reading_1.theme: Dicarboxylate transport and glutamate/nitrogen metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe sodium-coupled transport of succinate and other di- and tricarboxylates, framed as the movement of TCA intermediates that link to glutamate/glutamine metabolism, the malate-aspartate shuttle and nitrogen handling.

reading_2.theme: Dicarboxylate transport feeding glutamate-aspartate nitrogen metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover sodium-coupled uptake of TCA intermediates (succinate, citrate, alpha-ketoglutarate). Here they act as the supply of carbon skeletons and shuttle substrates for glutamate/glutamine/aspartate interconversion, the malate-aspartate shuttle and ammonium handling.

shared: response to cell cycle checkpoint signaling

reading_1.theme: DNA damage response to replication stress
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are genome stability maintenance through checkpoint responses and deubiquitination of monoubiquitinated repair proteins, framed as replication stress tolerance alongside ADP-ribosylation, crosslink repair and double-strand break repair.

reading_2.theme: Replication stress response and DNA repair regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways concern genome-stability control (DNA stability, checkpoint response, deubiquitination of monoubiquitinated repair factors such as FANCD2/PCNA), framed here within responses to replication stress, DNA-protein crosslink and R-loop repair and PARP-mediated ADP-ribosylation.

shared: Signaling by FGFR3 fusions in cancer
Signaling by plasma membrane FGFR1 fusions

reading_1.theme: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase fusions in cancer
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are constitutively active FGFR1/2/3 fusion signalling. Here they are one case of oncogenic RTK fusions and mutants, alongside ALK, LTK and PDGFR drivers and their kinase inhibitors.

reading_2.theme: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase fusions in cancer
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are FGFR1/2/3 fusion signalling, presented as one family of constitutively active RTK fusion drivers alongside PDGFR, LTK and ALK oncogenic kinases.

shared: negative regulation of sister chromatid cohesion

reading_1.theme: Mitotic exit: abscission and nuclear envelope reassembly
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe mitotic-phase cell-cycle functions and release of sister chromatid cohesion, framed here as the late-mitosis progression that leads into ESCRT-III-mediated nuclear envelope sealing, midbody abscission and cytokinesis.

reading_2.theme: Cohesin-mediated sister chromatid cohesion and its resolution
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame mitotic cell-cycle progression and negative control of cohesion as the timed release of cohesin-held sister chromatids, within a theme of cohesin loading, establishment, maintenance and separation.

shared: Synthesis of IPs in the nucleus
Synthesis of PIPs in the nucleus
Synthesis of pyrophosphates in the cytosol
Constitutive Signaling by AKT1 E17K in Cancer

reading_1.theme: Inositol phosphate and phosphoinositide signalling via PI3K/AKT
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe nuclear and cytosolic inositol phosphate/pyrophosphate synthesis and oncogenic AKT activation, framed as part of PI3K/AKT/PTEN signalling and its loss of control in cancer.

reading_2.theme: Phosphoinositide and inositol phosphate signalling and kinase regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame nuclear phosphoinositide and inositol pyrophosphate synthesis and AKT activation as lipid second-messenger kinase signalling, with PTEN and PAK2 regulation as its controls.

shared: Regulation of TLR by endogenous ligand
enriched in myeloid cells and monocytes
positive regulation of myeloid leukocyte mediated immunity
cellular response to oxidised low-density lipoprotein particle stimulus
complement and other receptors in DCs

reading_1.theme: TLR-driven monocyte and macrophage inflammatory response
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame myeloid inflammatory activation, including responses to endogenous danger ligands such as heme and oxidized LDL, as the cellular programme engaged by TLR2/4 sensing of bacterial lipids, MyD88/IRAK4 signalling and chemokine output.

reading_2.theme: Monocyte/myeloid inflammatory activation by endogenous danger signals
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover TLR and scavenger-type sensing by monocytes and myeloid cells of endogenous ligands such as oxidized LDL and heme. They form the trigger of myeloid inflammatory signalling, extended by complement-receptor signalling and neutrophil degranulation.

shared: regulation of retrograde protein transport, ER to cytosol
obsolete regulation of protein exit from endoplasmic reticulum
obsolete protein exit from endoplasmic reticulum
obsolete positive regulation of protein exit from endoplasmic reticulum

reading_1.theme: ER protein quality control and ER-associated degradation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame ER retention, mannose trimming and export gatekeeping as the quality-control checkpoint that decides whether proteins leave the ER or are retrotranslocated to the cytosol for ERAD.

reading_2.theme: ER protein quality control and secretory exit
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe ER retention, quality-control compartment, demannosylation and ER-associated retrograde transport, framed as quality control of proteins that have been targeted and inserted into the ER.

reading_1.theme: Neurotransmitter transport: vesicular loading and synaptic reuptake
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover SLC-mediated transport of neurotransmitters into synaptic vesicles and across the plasma membrane, including glycine transporter defects. Here they serve clearance and recycling of glycine, GABA and glutamate at synapses.

reading_2.theme: Neurotransmitter transport and reuptake at synapses
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe SLC-mediated vesicular loading and transport of neurotransmitters (including glycine transporter defects), framed as the transport machinery for glutamate, GABA and glycine reuptake and astrocytic recycling.

shared: negative regulation of Arp2/3 complex-mediated actin nucleation
regulation of barbed-end actin filament capping
positive regulation of actin filament depolymerization

reading_1.theme: Actin filament turnover driving protrusions and cell shape
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover cofilin/gelsolin-type actin disassembly: severing, depolymerization, barbed-end capping and restraint of Arp2/3 nucleation. This recycles actin so filopodia, ruffles and polarized cell shape can be remodelled downstream of EPHB and Rho-family signalling, including at synapses.

reading_2.theme: Actin filament turnover in cell shape and protrusion
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the disassembly side of actin dynamics, severing, depolymerisation, capping and Arp2/3 inhibition, which balance polymerisation to remodel filopodia, ruffles and cell polarity.

shared: Recruitment of NuMA to mitotic centrosomes
Loss of Nlp from mitotic centrosomes
Recruitment of mitotic centrosome proteins and complexes

reading_1.theme: Mitotic spindle assembly and cytokinesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are centrosome maturation and Aurora A/TPX2-driven spindle assembly, the early-mitosis spindle-building stage that precedes spindle elongation, checkpoint control and cytokinesis.

reading_2.theme: Mitotic spindle assembly, centrosome maturation and cytokinesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe centrosome maturation and Aurora A/TPX2-driven spindle assembly at mitotic entry, the early mitotic step that precedes spindle elongation, midzone assembly and cytokinesis.

reading_1.theme: Thyroid hormone synthesis: iodide uptake, peroxide and anion exchange
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the thyroid-specific core of hormonogenesis, NIS-mediated iodide uptake and thyroid hormone generation and transport, which the theme supports with H2O2 generation and SLC26 (pendrin-type) anion exchange.

reading_2.theme: Thyroid hormone synthesis and transmembrane transport of substrates
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame iodide uptake, hormone generation and thyroid hormone membrane transport as a transporter-dependent process, sharing carrier logic with the neutral and aromatic amino acid transporters in the additional set.

shared: protection from natural killer cell mediated cytotoxicity
granzyme-mediated programmed cell death signaling pathway
antigen processing and presentation of endogenous peptide antigen
regulation of natural killer cell degranulation
antigen processing and presentation of exogenous peptide antigen via MHC class Ib

reading_1.theme: NK and cytotoxic T cell killing and its regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe granzyme-mediated killing, NK degranulation and MHC class I/Ib antigen presentation that protects targets, framed as the effector and recognition core of NK/CD8 cytotoxicity and its tolerance controls.

reading_2.theme: MHC class I antigen presentation and NK/cytotoxic recognition
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe endogenous and class Ib antigen presentation, NK-mediated cytotoxicity and its inhibition, and granzyme killing, framed here as the cytotoxic-recognition outcome of the MHC class I loading and cross-presentation machinery in the additional set.

reading_1.theme: Magnesium, inositol and energy-phosphate transport and metabolism (loose)
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are magnesium ion transport/homeostasis and inositol transport plus protein oligomerization terms, framed as multimeric membrane transporters supporting Mg-ATP-linked energy and nucleotide-precursor metabolism; the cluster is only loosely coherent.

reading_2.theme: Membrane transport of ions and osmolytes
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover magnesium and inositol transport and homeostasis plus oligomeric membrane protein assembly, framed as osmotic/ionic homeostasis via channels and junctional paracellular transport under salt stress.

shared: Autointegration results in viral DNA circles
LRR FLII-interacting protein 1 (LRRFIP1) activates type I IFN production
Integration of viral DNA into host genomic DNA
Binding and entry of HIV virion
APOBEC3G mediated resistance to HIV-1 infection

reading_1.theme: HIV and herpesvirus replication cycle and host restriction
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover the early retroviral life cycle (entry, uncoating, reverse transcription, nuclear import, integration, latency), host restriction such as APOBEC3G, and control of viral transcription. Late-stage assembly and Nef/Vpu-mediated immune evasion complete the viral cycle.

reading_2.theme: Viral replication cycles and host-virus interactions
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame the retroviral (HIV) and herpesvirus life cycle, entry, reverse transcription, integration, latency and host control of viral transcription, as the DNA-phase viruses within a broader set of viral replication and host-translation hijacking by RNA viruses.

reading_1.theme: Lysosomal glycoconjugate catabolism and amino sugar metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe lysosomal breakdown of gangliosides and glycosides and its storage diseases, framed alongside sialic acid, amino sugar and nucleotide-sugar metabolism that supply and recycle glycan building blocks.

reading_2.theme: Lysosomal glycan catabolism and amino-sugar/N-glycan metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are lysosomal degradation of glycosphingolipids and gangliosides (HEXA/HEXB, NEU1 storage disorders), framed here as the catabolic end of a glycan metabolism network that also includes sialic acid, hexosamine and mannose synthesis, N-glycan processing and lysosomal enzyme targeting.

shared: positive regulation of axon extension involved in axon guidance
negative regulation of axon extension involved in axon guidance
collateral sprouting in absence of injury
obsolete neuron projection extension involved in neuron projection guidance

reading_1.theme: Axon guidance and collateral sprouting by netrin signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways concern regulation of axon extension, chemorepulsion and collateral branching, here driven by netrin attractive and repulsive signalling in developing sensory and guided axons.

reading_2.theme: Netrin-mediated axon guidance
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the growth-cone behaviours of axon extension, chemorepulsion and collateral sprouting, framed as the guidance outcomes that netrin signalling and its second messengers steer.

shared: positive regulation of focal adhesion assembly

[untitled BTM module] This grouping describes a mesenchymal, fibroblast-like programme in which mechanical and growth-factor cues are converted into matrix remodelling and stromal activation. Its hallmark outputs, the secreted matricellular proteins CCN1 and CCN2, are canonical readouts of YAP/TAZ activity downstream of cell stretch, stiffness and Rho signalling, and caveolin-1 links plasma-membrane mechanics to that response.

reading_1.theme: Mechanoresponsive fibroblast and stromal matrix remodelling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe YAP/TAZ-mediated mechanosignalling, focal adhesion assembly and collagen/TGF-beta programmes, framed as the fibroblast activation that builds and remodels connective tissue matrix.

reading_2.theme: Mechanoresponsive fibroblast and stromal matrix programme
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe YAP/TAZ-mediated mechanotransduction and focal adhesion signalling that convert mechanical and TGF-beta cues into fibroblast activation and matrix remodelling.

shared: ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process via the C-end degron rule pathway
nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, no-go decay
Ribosome Quality Control (RQC) complex extracts and degrades nascent peptide
ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process via the N-end rule pathway

negative regulation of nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, nonsense-mediated decay
PELO:HBS1L and ABCE1 dissociate a ribosome on a non-stop mRNA
tRNA-type intron splice site recognition and cleavage
Nonsense Mediated Decay (NMD) independent of the Exon Junction Complex (EJC)
Nonsense Mediated Decay (NMD) enhanced by the Exon Junction Complex (EJC)

reading_1.theme: Translation, ribosome quality control and RNA processing
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are translation termination, stalled-ribosome rescue/RQC and NMD/no-go decay, framed as quality control of cytosolic translation within the broader cytosolic and mitochondrial translation and tRNA-processing machinery.

reading_2.theme: RNA processing, surveillance and decay
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are cytoplasmic translational quality control and RNA decay (NMD, ribosome rescue, RQC and degron-mediated protein disposal), the surveillance end of an RNA life cycle that includes nuclear transcription, splicing, 3'-end processing and export.

reading_1.theme: Vitamin and cofactor uptake, transport and metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame riboflavin and thiamine transport and metabolism as the B1/B2 instance of micronutrient handling within a broader programme of vitamin (B12, folate, E, K) and quinone transport and metabolism.

reading_2.theme: Water-soluble vitamin and nutrient metabolism: B1, B2, carnitine, choline
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe thiamine and riboflavin uptake and metabolism, framed alongside carnitine and choline handling and the flavin-dependent FMO enzymes as related cofactor and nutrient metabolism.

shared: positive regulation of mesenchymal stem cell differentiation
positive regulation of mesenchymal stem cell proliferation

reading_1.theme: Wnt/BMP-driven osteoblast differentiation and skeletal development
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe Wnt control of mesenchymal stem cell expansion and osteoblast proliferation and differentiation, framed as the progenitor-commitment step of bone formation alongside RUNX2, BMP signalling and ossification.

reading_2.theme: Wnt-regulated osteoblast differentiation and bone formation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame Wnt control of mesenchymal stem cell and osteoblast proliferation and differentiation as the upstream osteogenic step leading to bone mineralization and maturation.

shared: DNA synthesis involved in DNA repair
Recognition of DNA damage by PCNA-containing replication complex
positive regulation of DNA-directed DNA polymerase activity
Gap-filling DNA repair synthesis and ligation in GG-NER
DNA strand elongation involved in DNA replication

reading_1.theme: DNA repair synthesis and translesion replication
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover replicative DNA synthesis, PCNA-mediated polymerase switching and translesion synthesis, framed as the DNA synthesis steps used in excision repair, mismatch repair and damage tolerance.

reading_2.theme: Translesion synthesis and replication-coupled DNA repair synthesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the replication-fork synthesis machinery (PCNA damage recognition, primer synthesis, elongation, polymerase switching and the TLS polymerases POLH/POLK/POLI/REV1), framed here as DNA synthesis deployed for damage tolerance and repair, including break-induced replication and sister-chromatid repair.

shared: Signaling by cytosolic FGFR1 fusion mutants
STAT5 activation downstream of FLT3 ITD mutants
FLT3 signaling through SRC family kinases

reading_1.theme: FLT3 and cytokine receptor signalling to STAT5 in leukemia
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover FLT3 (including fusion and ITD mutants) signalling through SRC kinases and STAT5 with CBL negative regulation, framed as the oncogenic driver signalling targeted by TKIs, alongside erythropoietin receptor signalling.

reading_2.theme: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase signalling in haematopoiesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe FLT3 signalling including ITD and fusion mutants, STAT5 activation and CBL-mediated negative regulation, framed as aberrant haematopoietic cytokine-receptor kinase signalling alongside PDGFR mutants and G-CSF/TPO signalling.

shared: CD4 T cell surface signature Th1-stimulated
negative regulation of dendritic cell differentiation
positive regulation of dendritic cell antigen processing and presentation
antigen processing and presentation, endogenous lipid antigen via MHC class Ib
positive regulation of dendritic cell differentiation

reading_1.theme: Antigen presentation and cytotoxic lymphocyte regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame dendritic cells and monocytes as antigen-presenting cells, including CD1 lipid presentation, that prime T cells and engage NK/NKT cells within a broader MHC presentation and cytotoxicity network.

reading_2.theme: Antigen presentation and cytotoxic lymphocyte activation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe dendritic cell differentiation, lipid (CD1) and protein antigen presentation, framed as the antigen-presenting side that activates T, NK and NKT cell responses and tolerance.

shared: obsolete neuron projection extension involved in neuron projection guidance
positive regulation of axon extension involved in axon guidance
negative regulation of axon extension involved in axon guidance
collateral sprouting in absence of injury

reading_1.theme: Netrin-mediated axon guidance
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the growth-cone behaviours of axon extension, chemorepulsion and collateral sprouting, framed as the guidance outcomes that netrin signalling and its second messengers steer.

reading_2.theme: Axon guidance and collateral sprouting
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways frame the positive and negative control of axon extension and collateral branching by repulsive guidance cues as the growth decisions shaped by Sema3A/CRMP signalling and innervation.

shared: [untitled BTM module] These genes converge on integrin-based adhesion and the cytoskeletal signalling that lets cells grip and respond to their extracellular matrix, with a supporting cast of metabolic and gene-regulatory proteins. Talin links activated integrin tails to actin, integrin-linked kinase couples the adhesion complex to downstream survival and contractility signalling, and a Rho GDP-dissociation inhibitor restrains Rho-family GTPases so that actin remodelling is switched rather than constant; a microtubule-associated protein and the SNARE-recycling factor alpha-SNAP tie the same events to cytoskeletal turnover and membrane fusion.
GRB2:SOS provides linkage to MAPK signaling for Integrins
p130Cas linkage to MAPK signaling for integrins

reading_1.theme: Platelet activation via integrin and GPCR signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are integrin adhesion signalling and cytoskeletal remodelling via Rap1, talin, p130Cas and GRB2:SOS, the adhesion arm of platelet activation triggered by thrombin, ADP, thromboxane and GPVI receptors.

reading_2.theme: Integrin-Rap1 signalling in platelet activation and adhesion
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are integrin adhesion signalling (Rap1, GRB2:SOS, p130Cas, talin/ILK cytoskeletal coupling) framed as the engine of platelet activation that drives cell spreading and degranulation.

shared: mesenchymal stem cell maintenance involved in nephron morphogenesis
obsolete cell differentiation involved in metanephros development
regulation of mesenchymal to epithelial transition involved in metanephros morphogenesis

reading_1.theme: Metanephric nephron development from intermediate mesoderm
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways frame the formation of intermediate mesoderm, maintenance of the nephron progenitor mesenchyme and its mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition into tubules as the core steps of nephrogenesis whose cell differentiation and patterning the additional pathways detail.

reading_2.theme: Early kidney development: intermediate mesoderm, ureteric bud, nephrogenesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe the metanephric mesenchyme side (intermediate mesoderm origin, progenitor maintenance, mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition into tubules), framed as the reciprocal partner of nephric duct and ureteric bud formation and branching.

reading_1.theme: Bile acid synthesis and peroxisomal lipid oxidation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe peroxisomal beta-oxidation (pristanoyl-CoA) and organic acid metabolism, framed as the organelle step that shortens sterol side chains in bile acid synthesis and homeostasis.

reading_2.theme: Peroxisomal and mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are generic organic acid metabolism and peroxisomal beta-oxidation of branched-chain pristanoyl-CoA, framed as the shared peroxisome-mitochondria fatty acid catabolism route that handles very-long, branched and medium chains.

shared: ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process via the C-end degron rule pathway
Cooperation of PDCL (PhLP1) and TRiC/CCT in G-protein beta folding
obsolete negative regulation of proteolysis involved in protein catabolic process
negative regulation of proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process
ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process via the N-end rule pathway

reading_1.theme: Protein quality control via proteasomal and autophagic degradation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the proteasome and ubiquitin/degron-dependent degradation machinery (with ERAD control, deubiquitinases and chaperone folding) that forms the proteasomal arm of clearing misfolded or unstable proteins, complementing the aggrephagy and autophagy routes.

reading_2.theme: Protein quality control: proteasome and selective autophagy
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are ubiquitin-proteasome degradation and its regulation (degron rules, ERAD, deubiquitinases, protein destabilization), the proteasomal arm of protein quality control that works alongside aggrephagy and chaperone-mediated autophagy to clear misfolded proteins.

shared: positive regulation of type II interferon production

reading_1.theme: Pattern-recognition-driven cytokine responses to fungi and pathogens
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways (IL-12, IFN-gamma and GM-CSF production) are framed here as the pro-inflammatory cytokine output of C-type lectin (Dectin-1/2, DC-SIGN) and TLR sensing of fungal and protozoan pathogens, balanced by IL-10 regulatory signalling.

reading_2.theme: Dendritic cell-driven Th1 immune activation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the cytokine outputs (IL-12, IFN-gamma, GM-CSF) produced by activated dendritic cells and T cells, framed as the signals that polarize T cells towards a Th1 response.

shared: positive regulation of multicellular organism growth
negative regulation of multicellular organism growth
positive regulation of insulin-like growth factor receptor signaling pathway
growth hormone receptor signaling pathway via JAK-STAT
regulation of growth hormone receptor signaling pathway

reading_1.theme: Endocrine control of growth and metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the class I cytokine-receptor hormones (growth hormone, prolactin, leptin) signalling through JAK-STAT and IGF to regulate body growth, framed alongside thyroid hormone production and action as systemic endocrine regulators of growth and metabolism.

reading_2.theme: Endocrine control of body growth and metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and IGF receptor signalling via JAK-STAT, framed as the somatotropic and metabolic hormone axis interacting with HPA-axis glucocorticoid secretion.

shared: obsolete regulation of catecholamine uptake involved in synaptic transmission
obsolete catecholamine uptake involved in synaptic transmission

reading_1.theme: Catecholamine neurotransmitter synthesis and transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are dopamine/norepinephrine synthesis and their synaptic reuptake and transport, implemented by SLC6 transporters (whose defects cause disease) and vesicular loading.

reading_2.theme: Catecholamine synthesis and monoamine neurotransmitter transport
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe dopamine synthesis and catecholamine transport and reuptake, framed as monoaminergic neurotransmission involving SLC6 transporters, vesicular loading and norepinephrine release.

shared: obsolete protein localization to endoplasmic reticulum exit site

reading_1.theme: Early secretory pathway ER-Golgi vesicle traffic
reading_1.core_role: The shared COPI budding, ER-exit-site and retrograde pathways serve as the Golgi-to-ER retrieval arm that recycles machinery and escaped ER proteins, complementing the COPII-driven ER export of cargo.

reading_2.theme: Bidirectional ER-Golgi vesicle trafficking
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover COPI vesicle budding and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic. This is the retrieval and recycling counterpart to COPII-mediated cargo export from ER exit sites.

shared: positive regulation of cGAS/STING signaling pathway
positive regulation of chemokine (C-C motif) ligand 5 production
positive regulation of dendritic cell cytokine production

reading_1.theme: Dendritic cell innate activation and Th1 priming
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are innate sensing and dendritic cell cytokine and chemokine production (cGAS-STING, response to protozoa, CCL5, STAT6 chemokines), framed as the trigger that leads to IL-12 and IFN-gamma driven Th1 responses.

reading_2.theme: Dendritic cell cytokine responses driving Th1 immunity
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe dendritic cell cytokine and chemokine production in response to pathogens and STING signalling, framed as the innate priming that drives IL-12, IFN-gamma and Th1 responses.

shared: Cholesterol biosynthesis from zymosterol (modified Kandutsch-Russell pathway)
isopentenyl diphosphate biosynthetic process, mevalonate pathway
obsolete cholesterol biosynthetic process via desmosterol

reading_1.theme: Mevalonate-derived isoprenoid, sterol and quinone biosynthesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the mevalonate/isoprenoid and cholesterol biosynthesis route, framed here as the source of prenyl (farnesyl, geranylgeranyl) units that also feed ubiquinone and vitamin K/menaquinone metabolism used for gamma-carboxylation of proteins.

reading_2.theme: Isoprenoid and sterol biosynthesis with vitamin K/quinone metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the mevalonate-isoprenoid route to cholesterol (lanosterol, Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell), framed as the source of prenyl precursors also used for ubiquinone and vitamin K quinones that support gamma-carboxylation.

shared: positive regulation of natural killer cell cytokine production
negative regulation of natural killer cell activation

reading_1.theme: NK cell activation and inhibitory receptor tolerance
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe KIR-mediated inhibitory control of NK activation and tolerance, framed as the regulation of NK cytotoxicity and granzyme killing by MHC class I recognition.

reading_2.theme: NK cell regulation and cytotoxicity
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are KIR-mediated inhibitory control of NK cell activation and tolerance, balanced against granzyme cytotoxicity and MHC class Ib recognition.

reading_1.theme: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe copper and manganese import, transport and detoxification (including aceruloplasminemia), framed as one arm of transition-metal homeostasis alongside SLC39/SLC30 zinc transport.

reading_2.theme: Transition metal ion homeostasis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are copper and manganese import, transport, detoxification and ceruloplasmin function, framed as one part of broader transition metal handling that includes iron export and cobalt transport.

reading_1.theme: Translation-associated modifications of tRNA and proteins
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are post-translational hydroxylation of lysine and proline residues, framed here among modifications that support translation (hypusine, diphthamide, tRNA modifications and aminoacylation).

reading_2.theme: Post-translational and tRNA residue modification for translation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are protein hydroxylation of lysine/proline residues, framed as one type of amino-acid side-chain modification alongside tRNA modification, hypusination and diphthamide synthesis that support translation.

shared: positive regulation of apoptotic process involved in development
positive regulation of cellular response to hypoxia
negative regulation of cellular response to oxidative stress

reading_1.theme: Hypoxia and oxidative stress-induced cell death regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways concern modulation of cellular responses to hypoxia and oxidative stress and developmental apoptosis, framed here as stress-induced intrinsic, mitochondria-dependent cell death, for example by hydrogen peroxide or oxygen-glucose deprivation.

reading_2.theme: Hypoxia and oxidative stress-induced apoptosis regulation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe how cells tune responses to hypoxia and oxidative stress and developmental apoptosis, framed as inputs to the mitochondrial intrinsic apoptotic pathway triggered by peroxide or oxygen-glucose deprivation.

shared: establishment of protein localization to chromatin

reading_1.theme: Chromatin assembly and ATP-dependent chromatin remodelling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are replication-coupled nucleosome deposition and organization, the chromatin packaging substrate that BAF and CHD remodelling complexes reorganize during replication, repair and stem cell maintenance.

reading_2.theme: Chromatin assembly and chromosome condensation, including centromeric CENP-A
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe nucleosome assembly and protein targeting to chromatin, which this theme frames as the chromatin-building basis for mitotic/meiotic chromosome condensation and CENP-A deposition at centromeres.

shared: positive regulation of tumor necrosis factor superfamily cytokine production
positive regulation of cytokine production involved in inflammatory response
negative regulation of toll-like receptor signaling pathway
positive regulation of toll-like receptor 4 signaling pathway
positive regulation of toll-like receptor 3 signaling pathway

reading_1.theme: TLR and inflammasome regulation of inflammatory cytokines
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are TLR3/4 signalling and IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, framed as innate microbial-sensing cytokine output alongside inflammasome and IL-1 processing.

reading_2.theme: Toll-like receptor signalling to inflammatory cytokine production
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways cover TLR3/4-driven production of TNF, IL-6 and IL-8 and its negative control, framed as the output of MyD88/TRIF adaptor, TRAF6/TAK1 and RIP1 signalling, including TRIF-mediated cell death.

shared: enriched in naive and memory B cells

reading_1.theme: B cell development, activation and proliferation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are generic lymphocyte and naive/memory B cell expression modules, framed as the identity signature underlying B cell differentiation and proliferation.

reading_2.theme: B cell identity and B cell receptor signalling
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are generic lymphocyte and naive/memory B cell transcriptional signatures, framed as markers of mature B cell identity with BCR signalling and activation toward antibody production.
